payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear rationale for using ESE methods on user-generated text, highlighting the unique characteristics of such text and the need for tailored benchmarks and evaluation metrics.

claims.text: User-generated text has distinctive characteristics that differ from well-formed text, necessitating the use of ESE methods to effectively mine entities from this data.
Existing benchmarks for ESE methods are inadequate for user-generated text, prompting the development of new benchmarks and evaluation metrics to assess performance accurately.
State-of-the-art ESE methods do not generalize well to user-generated text, often being outperformed by simpler baselines, indicating a need for specialized approaches.
